q: Is it worth moving my small factory from an LT to an HT electricity connection?
title: LT to HT connection: worth it?
short: Often, once load is large enough. HT energy rates are usually lower, but you must buy and maintain a transformer, and its losses fall on your side of the meter. Emissions per kWh do not change; your Scope 2 counts the units your meter records.
audience: Growing MSMEs near the LT load limit in their state

ul: Energy and demand charges under both tariffs for your monthly load.
Transformer, switchgear and civil cost, and annual maintenance.
Transformer no load and load losses, metered on the HT side.

p: An efficient transformer cuts the extra units you pay for. Choose a high efficiency rating; the losses run every hour of the year.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills, including kVAh, demand and solar export lines, into dated records with the units, factor and year behind every Scope 2 figure.
